title: 36 Hours in Dubai
abstract: Beyond the over-the-top luxury and futuristic towers, discover bustling souks, a contemporary art district and desert cycling trails.

title: 36 Hours in Venice
abstract: Winter — with its famous fogs and reduced crowds — provides breathing room and deepens the mysteriousness of Venice’s narrow passageways and centuries-old buildings.

title: 36 Hours in Innsbruck, Austria
abstract: Futuristic architecture rubs shoulders with centuries-old opera houses in this picture-perfect Austrian ski town.

title: 36 Hours in Palm Springs, Calif.
abstract: With its kitsch, color and joyous queer scene, this oasis in the Coachella Valley is all in on earthly pleasures.
